stories.headline: Formula 1 is heading to Rwanda in the 2030s
stories.summary: Formula 1 has announced a new grand prix in Kigali, Rwanda. The race is to run for at least 10 years, starting in the early 2030s on a new track. It would be the first Formula 1 grand prix in Africa since South Africa in 1993.

stories.headline: A van Gogh unseen in public for over 60 years
stories.summary: A painting by Vincent van Gogh called Chestnut Trees in Blossom is heading to auction. It has not been seen in public for over 60 years, and it comes from a private collection that also holds works by Cézanne and Renoir. The sale is expected to set a record.

stories.headline: A wreck off Turkey may be the world's oldest
stories.summary: A wreck discovered off the coast of Turkey is a new contender for the oldest shipwreck in the world. Its cargo has been described as a time capsule from 4,700 years ago. The ship was probably carrying huge jars of olive oil or wine across the Mediterranean when it sank to the seafloor.

stories.headline: Far-side rocks hint at why the Moon has two faces
stories.summary: The near side and the far side of the Moon look strikingly different, and a new study offers an explanation. Chang'e-6 became the first mission to return samples from the far side, in 2024, letting researchers compare rocks from both hemispheres. They suggest that uneven heating from Earth's gravitational pull drove enormous flows of ancient magma.
